name: hud_01
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game HUD icon sprite atlas. Use the attached image only as STYLE reference. Create NEW original drawings in exactly the same rough thick BLACK PENCIL contour, waxy colored-pencil grain, simple bold color areas, warm ochre/red/blue/green palette, slightly imperfect hand-drawing, angular off-white cut-paper sticker border. True transparent alpha outside each sticker. NO watercolor, NO smooth vector, NO shiny 3D, NO thin engraving. Legible at 24 to 44 pixels.
Exactly 5 columns by 5 rows, one isolated sticker per equally sized cell, centered, no overlap, generous transparent gutters, no labels or numbers or grid lines. Each object occupies middle 70 percent of cell.
Row1: science open book with blue flask; ideology rolled scroll with red seal and feather; economy golden coins in pouch; military crossed swords with shield; diplomacy two shaking hands with small olive sprig.
Row2: geography folded map with mountain; climate sun emerging from blue cloud; natural resources pickaxe and ore rock; biology tree with deer silhouette; clear map overlay folded blank map and small eraser.
Row3: elevation triangular mountain with snowcap; landform rolling hills and layered rock cross-section; biome landscape with pine and grass; temperature red thermometer; humidity blue water droplet.
Row4: wind curling wind ribbons with small leaf; ecology new sprout growing from soil; vegetation three green leaves; calendar blank parchment calendar with small red binding tabs; pause two thick red pencil vertical bars.
Row5: play green triangular pointer; speed three ochre right-pointing chevrons; settings gray cog with brown pencil; day and night golden sun overlapping crescent moon; eternal daytime large golden sun alone.
No text or letters. Preserve white paper cut edges like reference.
